name: Simpson Ridley Stribling — parents, behind a stepfather's guardianship (1820s Mississippi)
researcher_question: Who were the parents of Simpson Ridley Stribling, born 15 July 1821 in Amite County, Mississippi?
notes: #1413. BOTH parents stripped so the answer is not reachable from a marriage index keyed on the mother's surname: the route in is the Amite County Orphans' Court guardianship series. EITHER bond satisfies f4 — the 24 May 1825 bond naming Gideon Sleeper guardian to James, John, Seaborn and Ridley Stribling six months after he married their widowed mother (ark:/61903/3:1:3QS7-89QX-2C5P), or the 1823 bond appointing the widowed mother Margaret guardian of the same minors (ark:/61903/3:1:3QS7-L9QX-2H77). f4 scores either as an attached source but cannot tell which guardianship situation was engaged — both committed runs reached the 1823 bond, where no surname spread or stepfather appears at all, and neither landed the 1825 bond the stepfather inference actually turns on. f5 is a bonus (required: false) finding measuring that same discrimination: Margaret's 1824 remarriage to Sleeper encoded as a dated Couple relationship on her own node, with Sleeper never asserted as the subject's father. Bonus rather than required so an unmet stepfather-inference bar does not gate fixture validity, which f1-f4 already establish. See the 2026-08-17 and 2026-08-18 changelog entries in README.md. Reaching the bonds needs fulltext_search UNFILTERED (+Sleeper +guardian +Stribling); place/year filters return 0 because they match collection metadata. The 1815 marriage is indexed as 'Taliafero Stribbling'/'Peggy McDowell'. Caps sized to run 2's observed cost_cap straddle ($15.95/119.8 min against the $15 default).
